title: Paper Notes
description: Detailed reading notes on methods, evidence, and limits. Figures and tables stay close to the claims they support.

papers.authors: Yann LeCun, Yoshua Bengio, Geoffrey Hinton
papers.summary: Representation learning through gradients, spatial sharing and temporal sharing. Original derivations connect the mechanisms to evidence and limits.
papers.summary_zh: 从梯度、空间共享与时间共享理解表征学习。独立推导将机制与证据、适用边界连起来。

papers.paper_title: ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
papers.authors: Alex Krizhevsky, Ilya Sutskever, Geoffrey E. Hinton
papers.summary: Convolutional learning at ImageNet scale. Architecture, optimization, regularization and evaluation costs explain the result and its limits.
papers.summary_zh: 从结构、优化、正则化与评估成本理解 ImageNet 规模上的卷积网络，区分单模型、集成与额外预训练的证据。

papers.paper_title: Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers for High-Resolution Image Synthesis
papers.summary: Rectified flow at scale. The note connects the flow objective, MM-DiT, training choices, and evaluation.
papers.summary_zh: 把 Rectified Flow 放大到高分辨率文生图。精读包括训练目标、MM-DiT、实验和高分辨率配方。

papers.paper_title: InstaFlow: One Step is Enough for High-Quality Diffusion-Based Text-to-Image Generation
papers.summary: From reflow to one-step generation. The note follows the coupling, distillation objective, experiments, and costs.
papers.summary_zh: 先通过 reflow 改善配对，再蒸馏成一步模型。精读包括理论、算法、实验、成本和局限。
